cards.audioText: Approach clearance canceled, turn left direct to DA, climb to 4000 feet, hold as published, expect further clearance at time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: 取消近进许可，左转直飞DA，爬升到4000英尺，按公布程序等待预计进一步许可时间50分

cards.audioText: Hold south of AMS VOR at 9000 feet, inbound track 270 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute. Expect further clearance at 46.
cards.audioTextZh: 在AMS VOR台以南等待，高度9000英尺，向台航迹270，左等待，出航时间1分钟，预计进一步许可时间46分

cards.audioText: Cleared to the 180 radial of PER VOR at 15 DME. Hold south, left hand pattern, outbound time 2 minutes, expect approach clearance at 37.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以在PER VOR台180度径向线DME15海里处向南，左等待，出航时间2分钟，预计近进许可时间37分

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination, flight planned route, cruising level 330, departure Runway 04, initial altitude 7000 feet. HZ01 Departure, squawk 2563, departure frequency 124.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行到目的地，巡航高度层330，离场跑道04，起始高度7000英尺，HZ-01离场，应答机2563，离场频率124.35

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination via flight planned route, Runway 36R, LKO-01 Departure, initially climb to 4500 feet, cruising level 310, when airborne contact 119.7, squawk 2515.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经计划航路放行到目的地，跑道36右，LKO-01离场，起始爬升到4500英尺，巡航高度层310，离地后联系119.7，应答机2515

cards.audioText: Cleared via ZF-01 Departure, initial altitude 5000 feet. Departure frequency 125.9. Cruising level 290, departure Runway 04. Squawk 6563.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经ZF-01离场，起始高度5000英尺，离场频率125.9，巡航高度层290，离场跑道04，应答机6563

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination via flight plan route. Departure Runway 36L. HZ-01D Departure. Initial altitude 5000 feet. Cruising level 330. Departure frequency 119.45, squawk 5667.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以按计划航路放行到目的地机场，离场跑道36左，HZ-01D离场起始高度5000英尺，巡航高度层330，离场频率119.45，应答机5667

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination via flight planned route, initial climb to 2700 feet, request level change en-route, departure frequency 120.3, squawk 0722.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以按计划航路飞往目的地，起始爬升到2700英尺，航路上申请改变高度，离场频率120.3，应答机0722

cards.audioText: Hold on the 265 radial of BKM VOR between 25 and 30 miles DME, FL100, inbound track 085, right hand pattern, expected approach time 1022.
cards.audioTextZh: 在BKM VOR台265度径向线，DME距离25至30海里之间等待，高度层100，向台航迹085，右等待，预计近进时间1022

cards.audioText: Hold at 20 DME of ST VOR, FL100, inbound track 260 degrees, left turns, limiting outbound distance 24 DME.
cards.audioTextZh: 在ST VOR台DME 20海里等待，高度层100，向台航迹260，左等待限制出航距离DME24海里

cards.audioText: Hold at BKM VOR FL250, right hand pattern, expect further clearance at 23, landing delay at destination airport 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 在BKM VOR台等待，高度层250，右等待，预计进一步许可23分，目的地机场着陆延误30分钟

cards.audioText: Radar service is terminated due technical failure. Maintain Mach number decimal 81 or less for separation.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于技术故障雷达服务终止，保持马赫数.81 或更小以保持间隔。（4-5

cards.audioText: Radar control is resumed, track direct to BKM VOR and increase speed to Mach number decimal 84.
cards.audioTextZh: 雷达管制恢复，直飞BKM VOR台，增速到马赫数.84

cards.audioText: Position 42N（North） 165E (East) at 0800, FL390, estimating 44N 180E at 0900 45N 170W next.
cards.audioTextZh: 当前位置北纬42 度，东经165 度，时间0800，高度层390，预计到达北纬44 度、东经180度，时间0900，下一位置北纬45 度、西经170 度(5-6级)

cards.audioText: We have only one air conditioning pack operational. Request a new cruising level below FL300.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仅有一套空调组件工作，请求低于高度层300的新巡航高度

cards.audioText: We just had a smoke emergency. We need to depressurize the airplane to let in fresh air. Request rapid descent to 8000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们刚出现了烟雾紧急情况，需要释压让新鲜空气进入，请求快速下降到8000英尺。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: Our cabin altitude at one time had reached 16000 feet. Some passengers have symptoms of hypoxia.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们座舱高度曾达到 16000 英尺，一些乘客有缺氧症

cards.audioText: We are now ventilating with ram air. It is best that our rate of descent does not exceed 600 feet per minute.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们现在用冲压空气通风。最好下降率不要超过每分钟600英尺。

cards.audioText: The Morse code for the VOR is different from the approach chart. Confirm the VOR is fully operational.
cards.audioTextZh: VOR台莫尔斯码与近进图上不一致，证实VOR台正常运行中

cards.audioText: The approach lights for Runway 36L are a bit different from those shown on the airport diagram.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道 36 左近进灯与机场图上显示有点不同

cards.audioText: We have multiple failures on the inertial reference system. We are no longer able to fly oceanic route. Request return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们惯导系统多重失效，无法再飞海洋航路，请求返场着陆

cards.audioText: One of our generators has failed. At present moment, we are still able to continue to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们一台发电机失效，此刻，我们还能继续飞到目的地

cards.audioText: Electrical system has a serious malfunction. Request radar vectors to an airport that’s within 20 minutes of flight time.
cards.audioTextZh: 电气系统严重故障，请求雷达引导到飞行时间 20 分钟内的机场

cards.audioText: We have less than 10 minutes of battery power left. We are preparing for ditching procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们蓄电瓶飞行时间不足 10 分钟，我们正准备水上迫降程序

cards.audioText: We have switched off most of our electrical systems for smoke procedure. Request vectors for a long final, Runway 15.
cards.audioTextZh: 为了（执行）排烟程序，我们关掉了大部分电气系统，请求雷达引导到跑道15长五边

cards.audioText: The windshield suddenly had electrical arcing. We need to pull the circuit breakers and delay the approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 风挡突然出现电弧，我们需要拔出跳开关，推迟近进

cards.audioText: The cockpit side window is not sealed properly. Request reduce to minimum speed and descend to 4000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱侧窗无法正常密封，请求减速到最小速度，下降到4000英尺

cards.audioText: We had to go around due pilot seat moving. We’ll try to reset the circuit breaker before making another approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为飞行员座椅移动，我们不得不复飞。我们试着近进前，重置跳开关

cards.audioText: We have already discharged the engine extinguishers. The fire warning light is still on. Do you have a visual on our left engine?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经使用发动机灭火瓶，火警灯仍然亮着，你们能目视检查我们左发吗？

cards.audioText: We have an APU fire warning. Can you verify if there is smoke coming from the back of the plane?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有APU火警，你能确认一下我们飞机后部有烟雾冒出吗？

cards.audioText: The APU fire seems to be extinguished. Request fire trucks on standby and stairs vehicle to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: APU起火似乎被扑灭了，请求消防车待命，请求客梯车以便下客。（4-5

cards.audioText: We had a cargo smoke warning. Advise the ground handlers NOT to open our cargo door until the passengers have all disembarked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们出现了货舱烟雾警告，请告知地面装卸人员在所有乘客下机前千万别打开货舱门

cards.audioText: We have smoke coming out of our avionics bay. It is out of control. Request proceed direct to final and cancel all speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们电子设备舱冒烟，已经失控，请求直飞五边，取消所有速度限制

cards.audioText: Our pitch control has malfunctioned. We cannot move the elevators. We are flying the airplane with only trim.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们俯仰控制失效，升降舵无法移动，我们尝试用配平来控制飞机

cards.audioText: We have finished the checklist but still cannot retract some of the speed brakes. Request the longest runway for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们完成了检查单，但还是不能收起一部分减速板，请求最长的跑道落地我们无法完全放出襟翼，请求最长跑道落地我们襟翼不对称，飞机正向左横滚，请求等待解决故障

cards.audioText: We have asymmetric flaps. Airplane is rolling to the left. Request holding to solve the problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们襟翼不对称，飞机向左滚转。请求等待以解决问题。

cards.audioText: Request immediate climb above the minimum safe altitude to perform the checklist due to run-away trim condition.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于配平失控，请求立即爬升到安全高度以上，完成检查单

cards.audioText: Request return to FL250.We just had an air-upset situation and lost a lot of altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求回到高度 250，我们刚才有空中异常姿态情况，而且掉了很多高度

cards.audioText: We have lost electrical power to some of the flight control actuators. Request delay our descent to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们一些飞行操纵作动筒失去电气动力，请求延迟下降，执行检查单

cards.audioText: We have a severe fuel leak situation, unable to reach the closest airport. You can expect us to make a forced landing near our present location.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们燃油严重泄漏，无法抵达最近机场，估计会在当前位置附近紧急迫降。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: Our cabin crew reports that we have fuel leak from the right wing. Request diversion to closest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们客舱人员报告，右机翼漏油，请求备降到最近合适机场

cards.audioText: We have already shut down engine Number One, but it is still leaking fuel near the pylon. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们一发已经关车，但是发动机吊架附近仍在漏油，请求紧急服务

cards.audioText: The ground crew reports that we are leaking a bit of fuel from the bottom of the right engine nacelle. We are delaying taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 地面人员报告，右发吊舱下面漏油，我们打算推迟滑行

cards.audioText: We need to continue to run the engines at our present location for a few minutes, will advise you shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们需要在当前位置让发动机运转一会儿，很快告知你

cards.audioText: The ground crew reports that we are leaking a significant amount of fuel from the bottom of Number Three engine. We have just shut it down.
cards.audioTextZh: 地面人员报告，三发下面漏油严重，我们刚刚将三发关车了。（5-6

cards.audioText: The fuel leak has stopped. But if a fire starts at any time, I will order an evacuation.
cards.audioTextZh: 漏油停止了，但一旦有火警，我都会组织撤离

cards.audioText: We have leaked a large amount of fuel onto the apron. Request fire trucks on standby and the stairs vehicle to disembark the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有大量燃油漏在了机坪上，请求消防车和客梯车，让乘客下机

cards.audioText: We have fumes in the cabin, possibly due to a fuel leak. We are anticipating an immediate evacuation after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们客舱有烟味，可能是漏油了，预计会在落地后立即撤离。（4-5

cards.audioText: Our hydraulic systems have a malfunction. Request descent to lower levels to extend flaps in advance.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压系统故障，请示下降到低高度以便提前放襟翼。（4+级）

cards.audioText: Our hydraulic fluid is dangerously low, possibly due to a leak. Request descent to lower levels to extend flaps.
cards.audioTextZh: 液压油低得可怕，可能是漏油。请示下降到低高度放出襟翼。（4+

cards.audioText: Our ram air turbine is not providing any hydraulic pressure. We are still operating on one hydraulic system only. Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 冲压空气涡轮没有提供任何液压压力。我们仍然可以使用一个液压系统，请示备降到最近合适的机场。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: Both our windshield heating systems have failed. Ice is obstructing our view. Request latest airport weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们风挡加温系统失效，冰挡住我们视线，请求最新机场天气

cards.audioText: We had electrical arcing on the windshield and pulled the circuit breakers according to the checklist. Will advise when ready for approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 风挡出现电弧，我们已按检查单拔出跳开关。准备好近进时会通知。

cards.audioText: We performed the missed approach because my windshield wiper became inoperative and I could not see very well.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为风挡雨刷失效，我无法看清楚，我们复飞了

cards.audioText: We made the overshoot because of a stall warning, probably caused by a defective angle of attack probe.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为失速告警，可能是由于迎角探头误报造成的，我们复飞了。（4-5

cards.audioText: About twenty passengers and crew members were injured during the TCAS maneuver. Request diversion and medical assistance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 大约20名乘客和机组人员在机动飞行时受伤，请求备降，到场时需要医疗援助

cards.audioText: Engine indicates high EGT at idle power setting. We need to have partial thrust in the descent. Request an early descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机指示在油门慢车时显示EGT 较高，我们需要带部分推力下降请求提前下降

cards.audioText: Our fuel endurance is 48 minutes. We must leave the hold otherwise we will be at minimum fuel.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们燃油续航时间是48分钟，我们必须离开等待，否则我们将出现最低燃油

cards.audioText: It seems some of the spoilers cannot be retracted. We have to re-calculate our landing distance before we start our approach, standby.
cards.audioTextZh: 似乎部分扰流板无法收回。开始近进前我们必须重新计算着陆距离，请稍等。

cards.audioText: We have an indication that the nose wheel did not extend properly. Request low pass for visual check.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仪表显示前轮没有正常放出，请求低空通场目视检查

cards.audioText: We have lost our braking. We used thrust reversers to stop the aircraft. Request ground services to chock the nose wheel.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们失去了刹车，刚才使用反推停住飞机，请求地面服务用销子挡好前轮

cards.audioText: We made the go-around because our landing gear wouldn't extend normally. Request holding pattern to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 起落架无法正常释放，我们复飞了，请求等待完成检查单

cards.audioText: We applied maximum braking when we rejected takeoff. Request fire services to escort the aircraft back to the apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 中断起飞时，我们使用了最大刹车，请求消防车护送飞机回停机坪

cards.audioText: We made a go-around due to head-up display problem. We’ll inform you when we are ready for the approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为平显故障，我们复飞乐。准备好近进时，我们将通知你们。(4-5

cards.audioText: We do not have that runway in our database. Request delay our descent while we program the CDU.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们数据库里没有那条跑道，请求推迟下降，重新输入 CDU我们导航有故障，请求备降到较少复杂地形的合适机场

cards.audioText: Our oxygen pressure is dropping rapidly. Request to fly heading 050 and descent to FL180 to escape from the mountainous area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们氧气压力快速下降，请求航向 050，下降到高度 180 避开山区（5-6 级）

cards.audioText: The NOTAM says the ILS is unserviceable, but we are still picking up the Morse Code, confirm it is still in operation.
cards.audioTextZh: 航行通告说ILS不工作，但我们仍然收到莫尔斯代码，证实一下ILS仍然可用

cards.audioText: We have an engine failure. Following ETOPS procedure, request descent to FL200, maintain high speed and proceed direct to alternate airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们发动机失效，按照ETOPS 程序，请求下降到高度层200，保持大速度直飞备降场

cards.audioText: We cannot provide oxygen to the passengers as we are not sure where the smoke is coming from.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们无法给乘客提供氧气，因为我们不确定烟雾来源

cards.audioText: There was heavy smoke in the cabin before we ventilated the aircraft. Request medical assistance for passengers after landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们给飞机通风前有浓烟，请求落地后给乘客医疗救助

cards.audioText: The aircraft is depressurized. We are descending. Confirm 10,000 feet is enough to clear terrain until we reach our alternate.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机释压了，我们正在下降，证实到达备降场前 10000 英尺能否足够越障

cards.audioText: We are no longer getting bleed air from the right engine. Request immediate descent to leave the icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不再有来自右发的引气，请求立即下降离开结冰区

cards.audioText: We are unable to restart engine number one with bleed air. Request high speed for a windmill air start.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们无法用引气启动一发，请求大速度风转启动

cards.audioText: Both engine bleed air systems have failed and we are relying on APU bleed for air conditioning. Request descent to 14, 000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 两套发动机引气系统失效，正靠APU引气来提供空调，请求下降到14000英尺

cards.audioText: We have no bleed air coming from either engines or APU. Request rapid descent to 10,000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们没有任何来自发动机或APU的引气，请求快速下降到10000英尺

cards.audioText: Disregard my last CPDLC request for climb. We have a system problem and will maintain present level for now.
cards.audioTextZh: 请忽略上一条 CPDLC 爬升请求，我们系统发送故障，将保持当前高度

cards.audioText: We just had an APU fire warning, and discharged the fire extinguisher, Request visual check if there is smoke coming from our tail section.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们刚刚有过APU火警，也释放了灭火瓶，请求目视检查飞机尾部是否有烟雾

cards.audioText: Another aircraft has seen a lot of smoke coming from our APU. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 另一架飞机看到我们APU区域有很多烟雾冒出,我们正在紧急撤离请求紧急服务

cards.audioText: We have a generator failure and cannot start our APU at this altitude. Request descent to perform APU startup.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们一台发电机故障，在这个高度不能启动APU，请求下降重启APU

cards.audioText: A passenger has opened an over-wing emergency exit. The slide has deployed. Request to cancel our slot time.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘客打开了机翼紧急出口，滑梯已放出，请求取消我们的立场时间

cards.audioText: A passenger tried to unlock the cabin door in flight, the cabin crew restrained him. Request airport police on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘客企图在空中打开客舱门，客舱人员已将他制服，请求落地后机场警察到场

cards.audioText: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. Advise the fire fighters that it might be an electrical fire.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们电子设备舱有烟雾，请告诉消防员可能是电气起火

cards.audioText: Our thrust lever is not responsive. We cannot reduce thrust on engine Number One. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们推力手柄没有反应，我们无法减小一发推力，请求等待。（4-5

cards.audioText: We have a thrust reverser opened in flight. We cannot maintain this level. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 一台反推在空中打开。我们无法保持当前高度，请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: We still cannot retract the thrust reverser. Our approach speed will be higher than normal. Request vectors for the longest Runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仍无法收回反推。近进速度将高于正常值。请求雷达引导至最长跑道。

cards.audioText: Our EGT continues to be above the maximum limit. Request descent. We might shut down engine Number Two shortly.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们排气温度继续高于最大限制，请求下降，我们可能马上关掉二发

cards.audioText: The engine vibration is now causing the airplane to shake violently. We are shutting down our engine Number Three.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在发动机抖振引起飞机震动剧烈，我们正关掉三发

cards.audioText: We’ve made a visual inspection of engine Number Two from the cabin. The engine cowling has fallen off.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们从客舱里目视观察了二发，其整流罩脱落了

cards.audioText: Ground vehicle has collided with our engine nacelle. Maintenance work is needed before flight. Request cancel our airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 地面车辆撞到我们的发动机短舱。起飞前需要维修，请求取消航路许可。

cards.audioText: The Number Two engine has been shut down. We are no longer able to maintain level flight. Request descent to FL200.
cards.audioTextZh: 二发已关车，我们无法保持平飞，请求下降到高度层200

cards.audioText: The uncontained engine failure has caused parts of the fuselage to be damaged. Request emergency descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 发动机失效导致部分机身损坏，请求紧急下降

cards.audioText: There is a huge gaping hole in the aisle, somehow the cabin floor has been punctured. We are re-seating passengers. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱过道出现一个大洞，客舱地板不知为何被刺穿。我们正在重新安排旅客座位，请求等待。

cards.audioText: We have abnormal noise coming from the mid section of our fuselage, somewhere near the ceiling. Request descent and reduce speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 机身中段靠近天花板处有异常噪音。请求下降并减速。

cards.audioText: We are unsure about the cause of the explosion. There are injuries in the cabin. We’ll give you an update as soon as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不确定爆炸的原因，客舱有人受伤，我们尽快告知你们最新情况

cards.audioText: Some passengers have cuts and burn wounds due onboard explosion. Request diversion and medical services upon arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于机上爆炸，一些乘客有割伤和烧伤，请求备降，到场时需要医疗服务

cards.audioText: Ice is accumulating rapidly on the wings and fuselage. Request emergency descent to 6000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 冰快速积聚在机翼和机身上，请求紧急下降到 6000 英尺

cards.audioText: We had to descend immediately due to wind-shear at our cruise level. We didn’t have time to request descent as the frequency was busy.
cards.audioTextZh: 巡航高度遇到风切变，我们不得不立即下降，因为频率繁忙， 我们没有时间请求下降

cards.audioText: The airplane began to buffet when climbing through FL380. We had to stop climb immediately to increase airspeed.
cards.audioTextZh: 刚才爬升通过高度层380时飞机开始抖振，我们必须立即停止爬升以增加空速

cards.audioText: We are flying near our maximum altitude. We cannot maintain airspeed in this turbulence. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们接近最大高度飞行，遇到颠簸无法保持空速，请求马上下降。(4-5

cards.audioText: We encountered heavy rain and had a temporary flame out on our right engine. Request immediate climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遇到大雨，右发暂时熄火，请求立即爬升

cards.audioText: We have stopped on Runway 23 and will remain on the runway due heavy fog. I say again, we are still on the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在跑道 23 停了下来，雾大，仍然在跑道上，我再说一遍，我们仍然在跑道上

cards.audioText: There is heavy drifting fog. We think it is no longer safe to taxi. Request to hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 浓雾飘动，我们认为滑行不安全，请求原地等待

cards.audioText: Frontal weather is quickly moving in from the west. If the holding is more than 10 minutes, we will have to divert.
cards.audioTextZh: 锋面天气很快由西移动过来，如果等待超过10 分钟，我们将不得不备降

cards.audioText: There was temperature inversion when we descended through 3000 feet. Our airspeed dropped suddenly by 25 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们下降通过 3000 英尺时有逆温层，我们空速突然掉了 25 节

cards.audioText: We performed the missed approach below the minimum because of advection fog. We could no longer see the runway lights.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于平流雾，我们执行了低于最低高度的复飞，我们不能再看见跑道灯了。（5-6 级）

cards.audioText: The latest weather says that frontal weather and freezing rain is now stationary over the airport. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 最新气象报说，锋面天气和冻雨正在机场上空停留，请求备降。（4-5

cards.audioText: We can’t find any gaps for at least 100 miles in the squall line covering our arrival route. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 飑线覆盖了我们进场航路，至少100海里范围内，我们都无法找到任何空间穿越，请求备降

cards.audioText: We can see dust swirls approaching the airport and we’re concerned about low level wind-shear. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们能看到尘埃涡流接近机场，我们担心低空风切变，请求等待。（4-5

cards.audioText: The latest SIGMET says a super-cell thunderstorm is developing at our destination. Is our flight affected?
cards.audioTextZh: 最新SIGMET说，一个超级单体雷暴正在我们目的地机场形成，我们航班会受影响吗？

cards.audioText: Request to continue our flight. Our ETA is in two hours and maybe the airport will have the runways cleared of snow by then.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求继续飞行，我们预达时刻是2小时后，可能机场会在那时将跑道上的雪除干净

cards.audioText: We had to make a quick heading change due ice pellets. You didn’t answer our request so we squawked 7700 and made the heading change.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们因为冰丸必须快速改变航向。你没有回答我们的申请，因此我们设置应答机编码7700，并改变了航向

cards.audioText: We have just encountered a lightning strike. Some of our instruments have erroneous indications. Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们刚遭受雷击，一些仪表出现错误显示，请求备降到最近合适机场（5-6级）

cards.audioText: We have had a lightning strike. So far no system seems to be affected. We will continue to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遭遇雷击，至今没有系统受到影响，我们将继续飞往我们目的地

cards.audioText: Request to cancel our approach. Braking action is poor and we’re concerned about hydroplaning during rollout.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求取消近进。刹车效应差，我们担心着陆滑跑时发生水滑。

cards.audioText: We have received reports of freezing rain ranging from ground up to 5000 feet. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们收到了冻雨报告，范围从地面延伸到5000英尺，请求备降

cards.audioText: A sandstorm is forecast to reach the airport within 20 minutes. We won’t get airborne by then. Request cancel startup and tow back to the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计沙暴在20 分钟内到达机场，我们到那时还不能升空，请求取消开车并拖回停机位。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: Heavy blowing snow is expected to last for another 30 minutes. Request to terminate approach and holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 较大的风吹雪预计持续 30 分钟，请求终止近进、等待指令。（4-5

cards.audioText: Ice patches are covering the runway mostly along the runway edge. Uncontaminated runway width is about 30 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道结冰区域主要覆盖在跑道边缘，未污染跑道宽度约30米。

cards.audioText: A dissipating thunderstorm is ahead of us. We are near the zero-degree isotherm. Request deviate an additional 10 miles to the right.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们前方有在消散的雷暴，我们接近零度等温线，请求再向右偏置10海里

cards.audioText: We have a visual on a tornado at our 10 o’clock, about 2 miles. Request immediate right turn.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们看到在 10 点钟方向，大约 2 海里处有龙卷风，请求立即右转

cards.audioText: The weather forecast says that the typhoon along our route will be intensifying. Request change our airway clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 天气预报说我们航路的台风将会增强，请求改变我们的航路许可

cards.audioText: The hurricane has gathered in strength and will affect all airports at the south coast. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 飓风已大量聚集，而且将影响南海岸全部机场，请求备降

cards.audioText: We have entered volcanic ash. Our radios and engines are not working properly, now heading 235, and descending to FL 220, squawking 7700.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经进入火山灰，无线电和发动机都不能正常工作，当前航向235，下降到高度层220过程中，应答机编码7700。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: We are landing into the sun in heavy haze. Can you turn on the approach lights to maximum intensity?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在严重霾中迎太阳着陆，能把近进灯调到最大强度吗？

cards.audioText: The follow-me vehicle is leading us to taxiway L3. Our wings will not clear the other airplanes on this narrow taxiway. We are stopping.
cards.audioTextZh: 引导车正引导我们到滑行道L3，在这条较窄的滑行道上我们的机翼无法避开其他飞机，我们停止滑行了

cards.audioText: We are stopping. The ground marshaller is still guiding us in, but I think my engine will hit the boarding bridge if we taxi any further.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们停下来了，地面引导员仍引导我们滑入，但我认为如果我们再滑入，我们的发动机将碰到廊桥

cards.audioText: We are shutting down our engines. There are boxes blown by the wind toward our aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正关车，被风吹落的箱子向我们飞机袭来

cards.audioText: We had difficulty starting up our engines due strong tailwind. Request to change our pushback position facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于强顺风，我们启动发动机困难，请求改变推出位置，机头朝西

cards.audioText: Another aircraft has collided with us. I’ll command an evacuation as soon as we both turn off our engines.
cards.audioTextZh: 另一架飞机与我们相撞，在我们双方都关车后，我将下令尽快撤离

cards.audioText: The tow bar has been bent. Our maintenance crew will inspect our nose wheel. Holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 拖杆弯了，我们的机务人员将检查前轮，原地等待

cards.audioText: The tug has swung around and collided with our forward fuselage. We are shutting down engines. Request stairs vehicle and shuttle bus.
cards.audioTextZh: 拖车偏转撞到飞机前身，我们正关车，请求客梯车和摆渡车

cards.audioText: A catering truck collided with our aft fuselage. There are fumes in the cabin and we are quickly disembarking all passengers. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: services. (5-6级)餐车撞到了我们的后机身。客舱有烟雾，我们正在尽快让所有乘客下机。请求消防服务

cards.audioText: The flaps were extended inadvertently and hit the fuel truck. We are disembarking all onboard personnel. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: 襟翼无意中放出，碰到了油，。我们正在撤离机上所有人员，请求消防服务。(5-6级)

cards.audioText: Our airplane nose has now lifted off the ground due to improper load and balance. Request ground maintenance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于不正确的配载平衡，飞机机头已经翘起，请求地面维护

cards.audioText: We have discovered leakage of dangerous goods in the cargo hold. Can you alert hazardous material specialists?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已发现货舱里的危险品泄露，你们能通知危险品专家吗？（4-5

cards.audioText: The outer main landing gear might have rolled over runway lights when we made the one eighty turn. Request personnel to inspect.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们180 度转弯时主起落架可能擦到了跑道灯，请求人员检查。(4-5

cards.audioText: A passenger has assembled a bomb in the lavatory. He is making threats. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘客已在厕所安装了一枚炸弹，他正在威胁我们，请求紧急服务

cards.audioText: We made a very hard landing. We’ll need maintenance inspection before our next flight. Suggest you check the runway touchdown zone.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们重着陆了，下次飞行前我们需要机务检查，建议你们检查跑道接地区

cards.audioText: I can read you, but I’m not sure you can hear me. I will squawk ident to comply with your instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我能听到你，但不确定你能否听到我。我将识别应答机以执行你的指令。

cards.audioText: I have heard an aircraft in distress but no one’s responding. I can help relay his message.
cards.audioTextZh: 我听到一架航空器遇险，但无人回应。我可以帮助转发其信息。

cards.audioText: Message relay: The aircraft in distress will ditch in the ocean. His present coordinate is One Eight Degrees, One Five Minutes, North, One Six Zero Degrees, Five Two Minutes East.
cards.audioTextZh: 转报：遇险飞机将海上迫降。目前坐标是18度15分北，160度52分东（6级）

cards.audioText: The aircraft in distress says he will attempt to force land in an area about ten miles Northeast of his position.
cards.audioTextZh: 遇险飞机说，他将尝试在其位置东北10海里区域迫降

cards.audioText: Request diversion. The latest weather at our destination suggests snow storm will last for 5 hours.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求备降，目的地机场最新天气表明，雪暴将持续5小时

cards.audioText: Our radar shows a strong echo from the thunderstorm ahead. Request immediate right turn to avoid it.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们雷达显示，前方有强烈雷暴回音，请求立即右转避开

cards.audioText: A passenger activated the overhead emergency oxygen generator. Request airport security on arrival to detain this individual.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘客触发了顶部紧急氧气发生器，请求机场保安到场拘留他

cards.audioText: We have a passenger with severe hyperventilation. He has received first aid but his condition is not improving. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客严重过度换气，已接受急救但情况未改善。请求落地后救护车到场。

cards.audioText: There was a fight onboard among a few passengers. One of them is now bleeding seriously. Request police and ambulances on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 几名乘客在机上打架，其中一个人流血严重，请求警察和救护车到场

cards.audioText: The purser told me the injured passenger has blood type O. Maybe this information is useful to the paramedics.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务长告诉我伤员血型为O型。也许这个信息对医护人员有用。

cards.audioText: A passenger is unconscious after suffering from seizure. The cabin crew is giving her first aid. We will advise if we require a diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名乘客癫痫发作，失去知觉，客舱人员正在急救。如需备降，我们将告知你们

cards.audioText: Many passengers and crew were injured due severe turbulence. We will advise the number and severity of injuries when able.
cards.audioTextZh: 因为严重颠簸，许多乘客和机组人员受伤，如果可以的话，我们将告知受伤人员和受伤程度

cards.audioText: An elderly passenger has passed away. We will continue to our destination. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一位年长的乘客去世了，我们将继续到目的地，请求救护车到场。（4-5

cards.audioText: We found a passenger unconscious from a drug overdose in the lavatory. Request police and ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们发现一名乘客在洗手间服药过量失去意识，请求警察和救护车到场

cards.audioText: The sick passenger’s condition has improved. We no longer require the diversion. Request to continue to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 生病乘客的情况已经好转，我们不再要求备降，请求继续飞往目的地

cards.audioText: We received an emergency call from the cabin, but now nobody is responding. We can hear shouting and disturbance. Our cabin crew might be under duress.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们收到客舱紧急呼叫，但现在没人回应，我们能听见喊叫声和打斗声，客舱人员可能受到了胁迫。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: We can see two masked men with sharp weapons on our cockpit door surveillance camera. They are kicking the cockpit door.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们通过驾驶舱监控摄像机看见两个头戴面具，手拿利器的人，他们正在踢驾驶舱门。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: I can see the area outside of the cockpit. There are two hijack suspects standing in the aisle.
cards.audioTextZh: 我能看见驾驶舱外面区域，有两名劫机者正站在过道里

cards.audioText: One of the terrorists is about forty-year old. He is about 180 cm tall, wearing a brown shirt and dark pants.
cards.audioTextZh: 其中一名恐怖分子大约40 岁，他有180 厘米高，身穿棕色衬衫和深色裤子

cards.audioText: A terrorist is trying to access the cockpit. He is about 30 years old. He is wearing a hat and backpack.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名恐怖分子正试图接近驾驶舱，他大约30岁，头戴一顶帽子，背有双肩包

cards.audioText: The purser reports there are over ten hijackers onboard. They are threatening to kill passengers if we don’t fly to another destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 乘务长报告机上有超过10名劫机犯，他们正威胁我们，如果不飞往另一个目的地，他们就杀死乘客。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: We will remain on the runway. The hijackers have taken four hostages to the rear of the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们将停留在跑道上，劫机犯把四名人质带到了客舱后部

cards.audioText: We are unsure of our position due to navigation failure. If any station can hear me, please respond.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于导航故障，我们不确定当前位置。如任何电台能听到，请应答。

cards.audioText: We only have standby magnetic compass due instrument failure. Now heading 245. Request navigation assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仪表失效，只有备用磁罗盘，现在航向245，请求导航援助

cards.audioText: We are unsure of our position due FMS failure. Last known position five miles north of FUPAD, now heading 165 for weather avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于飞行管理系统失效，我们不确定当前位置，最后已知位置是PUPAD以北5海里，当前航向165以避开天气。（6级）

cards.audioText: A ramp inspection discovered crates of lithium batteries in the cargo hold. We are verifying. Request delay pushback.
cards.audioTextZh: 机坪检查发现货舱有数箱锂电池，我们正在核实，请求延迟推出。（4-5

cards.audioText: We had a smoke warning in the cargo hold. We have discharged the fire extinguisher. We are concerned about lithium batteries in that compartment.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们货舱有烟雾警告，已经释放灭火瓶，我们担心货舱里的锂电池（5-6级）

cards.audioText: Request passenger stairs connect immediately after we stop on the runway. We want to disembark passengers as quickly as possible.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们停止在跑道上后，请求立即连接客梯车，我们想尽快让乘客离机

cards.audioText: We nearly collided with that aircraft. We had very little vertical separation. Do you know the flight number of that aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们几乎与那架飞机相撞，我们之间几乎没有垂直间隔，你们知道那架飞机的航班号吗？

cards.audioText: We have about thirty injured persons on board, four are very serious. Can you deliver this message to the medical staff that are standing by?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们机上有三十人受伤，其中4 让人受伤严重，你能把此消息告知待命的医务人员吗？

cards.audioText: We are declaring minimum fuel. We will have less than 30 minutes endurance by the time we get to our destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们宣布最低燃油量，到达目的地机场时，我们燃油续航时间将少于30分钟

cards.audioText: We are declaring fuel emergency. Our endurance is 1 hour 58 minutes. We are 1 hour 30 minutes from the closest alternate airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况，我们的续航时间是1小时58分钟，而我们到最近备降场时间是1小时30分钟

cards.audioText: We have been intercepted by a military aircraft. It is rocking its wings to indicate we should follow.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们被一架军用飞机拦截了，它摇动机翼让我们跟在（后边）

cards.audioText: I’m trying to identify the type and nationality of the military aircraft. So far, no response on 121.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正试着识别军用飞机的机型和国籍。到目前为止，121.5频率仍没有回应

cards.audioText: We are heading 085. This heading allows us to quickly exit the prohibited airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们航向085。这个航向能让我们快速离开禁区。

cards.audioText: If we continue to make orbits we will exceed our duty time limit by the time we land.
cards.audioTextZh: 如果继续盘旋，我们将在落地时超出执勤期限制

cards.audioText: They have revived the unconscious passenger by CPR procedure. It looks like he’ll be fine. Request to cancel the diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 他们通过心肺复苏程序使失去知觉的乘客恢复了意识，他似乎情况转好，请求取消备降。（5-6级）

cards.audioText: Unable speed 180 knots. We need to maintain a good speed in clean configuration due icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能保持速度180节。由于积冰，我们需要在光洁构型下保持良好的速度

cards.audioText: Unable to reduce speed below mach decimal 74. You can vector us if you’d like.
cards.audioTextZh: 无法减速到马赫数.74。如果可以，你可以雷达引导我们

cards.audioText: Unable, an immediate right turn might not give us enough terrain clearance. Our turn radius is 4 miles at this speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 不行，立即右转可能导致越障阈度不够，当前速度的转弯半径是 4 海里

cards.audioText: Our aircraft has the required certification and is approved by your Civil Aviation Authority for scheduled flight.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们飞机有相应资质，你们民航当局也批准执行定期航班
